plain.text: One afternoon Peter and John went up to the temple to pray. A man who had been lame from birth was carried there every day to beg at the gate called Beautiful. He asked them for money. Peter looked at him and said, "Silver or gold I do not have, but what I have I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, walk." Peter took him by the right hand and helped him up, and instantly his feet and ankles became strong. He jumped to his feet and went into the temple courts with them, walking and jumping and praising God. Everyone recognised him and was amazed.

A crowd ran to them at Solomon's Colonnade. Peter said, "Why are you surprised? It was not by our own power that he walks. The God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob has glorified his servant Jesus." Peter said they had disowned the Holy and Righteous One and asked for a murderer instead. "You killed the author of life, but God raised him from the dead. We are witnesses of this." It was faith in Jesus' name that healed this man. Peter said they had acted in ignorance, but this was how God fulfilled what the prophets said about the Messiah's suffering. "Repent, then, and turn to God, so that your sins may be wiped out, and times of refreshing may come from the Lord." God sent his servant first to them, to bless them by turning each of them from their wicked ways.

summary.bigIdea: In Jesus' name a lame man walks, and Peter calls the crowd to turn to God for forgiveness and refreshing.
points: "Silver or gold I do not have, but what I have I give you."
The healed man walks and leaps, praising God.
Peter tells the crowd that the risen Jesus healed him, and calls them to turn to God.
summary.reflection: Peter gave what he had, not what he didn't. What do you have that you could share with someone?
